stage: Stage 2 Pass 2 — Independent Second Greek Source-Language Verification & Applied Edits
strict_isolation: Greek-only (zero exposure to Hebrew or Latin editions/translations)

summary.disputed_accounting: 59 Pass 1 human-editor-linked source verses (28 Rule 4 Messianic/Spirit/pistis policy anchors, 18 NT sperma loci, 10 1 Chr 5-7 Swete/B loci, 3 OT syntax/punctuation judgment calls) + 1 Chr 5:36 (paired by Pass 2 with rejected 1 Chr 5:35 under GRC-HQ-005/010) = 60 disputed source verses awaiting human editorial policy ratification.
summary.parity_reconciliation: 34,198 (SGCT Stage 1) + 1 (Sirach Prologue separated from 1:1) - 3 (Sirach 30-36 3 merged pairs: 35:4, 36:1, 36:10) = 34,196 ME entries (all 12 Stage-1-removed duplicate/phantom unplaced entries removed in Pass 2).

out_of_canon_scope.note: Studio v10 Stage 1 adopts the 12-chapter Theodotion Daniel (including Prayer of Azariah & Song of the Three at Dan 3:24-90) and excludes Susanna as outside the locked 70-book Saints Greek canonical scope. Documented in GRC-HQ-009.
